title: Dune Allen "Boogie's Bellagio" 11 E Seahorse Circle
h1: Dune Allen "Boogie's Bellagio" 11 E Seahorse Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located in beautiful and quiet Dune Allen- Wrap-around porch with bed swings- Low-Speed Vehicle- Open floor plan- 2-minute walk to the beach- Private pool and spa **Pool heating available Oct 1–May 1 for $50 per day** Please note the pool and spa are heated together- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Boogie’s Bellagio is a 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom Dune Allen home that sleeps 13. This cottage is in a peaceful and relaxing setting that’s a 2-minute walk to the beach! Guests will love the private pool, wrap-around porch with bed swings, an included golf cart, and the cheerful interior. Guests climb a flight of stairs and enter the home on the second floor, where a wonderful wrap-around porch with rocking chairs and a porch swing enjoys warm beach breezes and views of the beach access and large fenced-in yard. Stepping inside, guests will be delighted by a bright, open kitchen, dining, and living space with colorful pops of orange, green, and blue. A long dining table with vibrant chairs stands center stage, dividing the kitchen and living space. A gleaming white kitchen with premium appliances, a farmhouse sink, and an island with green tile accents faces a living area with a wrap-around sofa, leather armchairs, and rattan tables positioned around a painted fireplace with a flat-screen TV. A guest bedroom with a king 4-poster bed has French doors that open to the porch and a private bathroom with double vanity and a spacious glass-enclosed shower. A second guest bedroom has a tropical upholstered king bed, French doors that open to the porch, and a private bathroom with a double vanity and a glass-enclosed shower. On the first floor, guests can relax in a second living room richly appointed with a velvet full sleeper sofa and dusty rose velvet chairs. A sophisticated bunk room has 2 twin-over-queen bunk beds, front yard views, and a private bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower. A guest bedroom has a king bed, rich blue accents, and a private bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower. Stepping outside, guests will find a large outdoor living room and pool deck where they can relax on a generous wrap-around sofa and watch TV, or enjoy freshly grilled fish at an outdoor dining table. Guests can recline on yellow lounge chairs when not enjoying the beautiful pool and sitting spa. An outdoor shower and parking for the golf cart are on the side of the home, while 2 colorful bed swings enjoy breezes at the front. Guests can also explore Dune Allen Beach and nearby shops and restaurants on 4 included adult bikes. With this location and these furnishings, Boogie’s Bellagio will book quickly. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 13):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin over Queen Bunk beds, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Room: Full Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
